# JSON boundary dependency

`nlohmann/json.hpp` is the unmodified single header from JSON for Modern C++
3.12.0, downloaded from
<https://github.com/nlohmann/json/blob/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp>.
Its MIT license is retained in `nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT` and in the source header.
The engine uses JSON at its process interface and for trace records; braid
words and Laurent coefficients have native representations during execution.
